definitions.gloss: inn waitress, ryokan attendant, traditional restaurant server
definitions.explanation: A female attendant at a traditional Japanese inn (ryokan) or traditional restaurant (ryoutei) who serves food, prepares rooms, and attends to guests. Typically wears a kimono.

examples.japanese: {仲居|なかい}さん⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{案内|あんない}して→案内する：20203_annaisuru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The inn attendant showed us to our room.

examples.japanese: {仲居|なかい}さん⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}て→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運|はこ}んで→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧きた。
examples.english: The inn attendant brought the meal wearing a kimono.

examples.japanese: ⟦{老舗|しにせ}→老舗：16152_shinise⟧⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仲居|なかい}さん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦おもてなし→おもてなし：16856_omotenashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{行|ゆ}き{届|とど}いて⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦{滞在|たいざい}→滞在：03390_taizai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{快適|かいてき}→快適：00140_kaiteki⟧だった。
examples.english: The attendants at the long-established ryokan had thorough hospitality, making the stay very comfortable.

notes:
Traditionally a female role. Usually addressed as {仲居|なかい}さん with the honorific さん. The role is closely associated with Japanese hospitality culture (⟦おもてなし→おもてなし：16856_omotenashi⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仲居|なかい}さん (inn attendant — with honorific)
- {仲居|なかい}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ (to work as an inn attendant)
- ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仲居|なかい} (ryokan attendant)
- ⟦{料亭|りょうてい}→料亭：21710_ryoutei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仲居|なかい} (traditional restaurant attendant)

CULTURAL NOTE:
At a ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧, the {仲居|なかい} typically welcomes guests, serves tea, explains the room and facilities, brings meals to the guest room, and lays out the ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧ (futon bedding). The role is a central part of the traditional Japanese inn experience.
